name: Table Runner (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
descriptionHtml:
Enhance your table presentation with our Custom Table Runner, designed to add bold branding and a professional touch to any event setup. Perfect for trade shows, vendor booths, conferences, and promotions, this runner delivers high-impact visuals without covering the entire table.

Printed using full-color dye sublimation with full bleed, your artwork appears vibrant, crisp, and long-lasting. The sleek runner design allows your brand to stand out while maintaining a clean, modern table display.

🔹 Key Features

🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, vibrant, fade-resistant graphics
🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge custom branding
🧵 Display Polyester Fabric – Smooth finish with professional drape
⚙️ Easy Setup – Simply lay over any standard table
🧳 Lightweight & Portable – Ideal for travel and events
🏷️ Versatile Branding – Perfect accent for existing table covers

🔹 Available Sizes

📐 24" × 80"
📐 34" × 80"
📐 60" × 80"

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Display Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, brand activations, and corporate events.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
